lookahead_policy: No phase6 historical backtest. Decision-time vintage sealed before next open; future adjusted revisions never rewrite past predictions/executions. Pre-registration historical values are unverified PIT and excluded from promotion.
remaining_limits: Current254 constituents omit historical delistings/survivors; never claim selection-bias eliminated.
Internal bar checks are not independent exchange reconciliation.
Independent complete historical coverage0; no promotion if benchmark/price histories unvalidated.

sector_proxy.method: Existing leave-target-out equal-weight peers,>=3 and80% coverage; no historical official sector claim

source_inventory.corporate_actions: Raw dividends/splits and factor changes inspected; full rights/capital-action/PIT vintages unavailable; active position freezes on an action/revision.
source_inventory.decision_feed: Yahoo via production yfinance auto-adjusted; archived vintage only; no claim of historical PIT availability

execution_feed.basis: published raw OHLCV, no auto adjustment/repair

source_inventory.limits: One bounded Yahoo batch (internal4 threads,240s timeout); four public probes20s each, no retry on denied access; no paid data. Complete raw download hashes retained, current raw bars sealed; full inputs in artifact90days.
source_inventory.rights: Yahoo personal/research-only notice: https://ranaroussi.github.io/yfinance/ ; no source wall/403/paywall/rate-limit bypass. Public quote page does not establish a licensed historical feed. Saudi Exchange public historical/market-watch and Mubasher/Stooq probes report actual coverage, not assumed entitlement. Twelve Data XSAU paid entitlement is not a verified free alternative.
